scenarios.request: the villain should tower over us, shoot Joon from below
scenarios.why: Looking up at him gives him the power in the room.

scenarios.request: look down on Joon so he feels small and beaten
scenarios.why: A camera above him shrinks him; only the mood says so, hence low confidence.

scenarios.request: a dutch tilt as the floor starts spinning in her head
scenarios.why: The tilted horizon is the spin; floor and head are not shot names here.

scenarios.request: god's eye view of the two of them on the tiles
scenarios.why: Straight down turns the couple into a pattern on the floor; "two" is a count, not a two-shot.

scenarios.request: keep the camera at eye level on Mara, nothing showy
scenarios.why: Eye level is the honest, unjudging height.

scenarios.request: from the ground looking up at Joon
scenarios.why: From the floor the angle is the worm's eye; the low angle it also implies is dropped, one angle per stack.

scenarios.request: Mara in profile against the window
scenarios.why: Side-on shows her outline against the light.

scenarios.request: a slight cant to the frame, she is nervous
scenarios.why: A small tilt for nerves; the resolver reads it from the mood alone.

scenarios.request: head on as Joon walks toward the lens
scenarios.why: Straight at the lens is a confrontation with the audience.
